body:
Feedback from a few days of watching dozens of work pull requests, most of them on Buildkite: most `checks success → failure` pushes were stale or unactionable. This is the check-reading half of the fix. Holding red until a second reading agrees, and batching pushes, follow in a separate PR because they change [`push.rs`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/84313de/src/push.rs).

**Commit statuses are read.** Buildkite posts a commit status, not a check run, and the query only selected `CheckRun`. A red status was never named, and GitHub's verdict was trusted even when the only other red was a superseded run. The query now selects `StatusContext { context state }`. Each status is its own check ([`identity`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/84313de/src/adapters/github.rs#L545)) because GitHub keeps only the newest per context, and `PENDING`/`EXPECTED` count as running ([`running`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/84313de/src/adapters/github.rs#L578)). Fixture recorded from [buildkite/agent#4460](https://github.com/buildkite/agent/pull/4460), whose label check was re-run green beside a red Buildkite build.

**`github.ignore_checks`.** A list of exact check names that never turn a pull request red or hold it pending, for things like a merge lock or a label policy ([buildkite/agent#4458](https://github.com/buildkite/agent/pull/4458) is red only because of "Require category label"). [`Response::ignore`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/84313de/src/adapters/github.rs#L321) drops them before anything judges the rollup. Once any check is dropped, the verdict comes from what's left, because GitHub's own state still counts the dropped checks. [`GitHubProvider::from_config`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/84313de/src/adapters/github.rs#L35) is now the only way callers build the provider, so none of them can miss the list.

**A broken query is an error.** While adding the status fields, one extra brace made every pull request read as vanished (`wait` exit 5, "no such reference"). A GraphQL error with no path now becomes `RefError::Other` with GitHub's message ([`interpret`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/84313de/src/adapters/github.rs#L252)). A test now checks that the generated query's braces balance.

**Prose no longer names a watch target.** Opening this PR also watched buildkite/agent#4458 and #4460, because the PR body, written by a heredoc in the same Bash call as `gh pr create`, linked to them. The `post-tool` hook now reads only the `gh pr` command's own segment, up to any `--body`/`--title` ([`arguments`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/75c58c0/src/domain/detect.rs)). It reads none of `create`'s arguments and none of `view`'s output, because `view` prints the body. Cost: a bare `gh pr view` no longer counts as touching the current branch's PR, though `git push` still does.

The feedback is recorded in [`docs/dogfood.md`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/84313de/docs/dogfood.md).

Verified live: `inkling wait --until checks` against buildkite/agent#4460 and #4458, using scratch state paths.

Dogfood: the `post-tool` hook registered this PR when it was opened (rung 4), plus the two stray watches above. A background `inkling wait --until checks` returned green after 1m 39s. The push `inkling: github.com/dpep/inkling#26 checks pending → success` arrived mid-turn about 15s later and was actionable without another lookup. The wait and the server each polled on their own.
